answer: Agents selling pigment demand forecasts for a mural of the horizon viewed from a ledge protect customer records with differential privacy. The data service charges each released statistic against one dataset-wide privacy budget, atomically reserving its cost before release and refusing queries when exhausted. It does not grant fresh budgets to new accounts. A swarm therefore cannot average unlimited noisy answers to expose customer purchases. This requires correct privacy composition; attackers can still exhaust the shared budget.
